個景點・ PLACES

臺南遊客導覽Tainan Visitor Guide

福爾摩沙小導遊 Little Guides of Formosa

每個景點一頁：一分鐘動畫影片、景點介紹、實景照片，按 🔊 可收聽英文。
One page per site: a one-minute animated intro, the story of the place and real photos. Tap 🔊 to hear the English.

想順路走完一區，選路線，照編號一站一站走；想查某個景點，從分區找。每個景點頁最下面都有「上一站・下一站」，看完可以接著走。
Pick a route to walk stop by stop, or find a place by district. Every place page ends with the previous and next stop.

搜尋結果Results・

找不到符合的景點。試試其他關鍵字，例如廟名、街名或英文名稱。
No matching places. Try a temple, a street or an English name.

散步路線Walking routes

把相鄰的景點串成一條路線，點景點看介紹，最下面可以用 Google 地圖導航整條路。
Nearby places linked into walks. Tap a stop to read about it, or open the whole route in Google Maps.

示意圖：依景點實際位置畫出，不是街道地圖。點路線或下面的名稱，就會打開那條路線。
A sketch map drawn from real locations, not a street map. Tap a route or its name to open it.

臺南先行，其他縣市陸續加入。Tainan first; more of Taiwan is on the way.
